defs.def: to say that you will cause trouble, hurt sb, etc. if you do not get what you want 扬言要；威胁；恐吓

ex.s: So, as climate change and biodiversity loss threaten natural scents, many people may not even notice.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的"气味景观"，热浪和污染正在使其发生变化。

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 雪——已受到气候变暖的威胁——随着气温升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变它清冷洁净的气味。

ex.s: Climate change is also quickening the loss of biodiversity, threatening to erase certain smells entirely.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们的气味变得更加难以产生。

ex.s: Rapid economic development threatens animal habitats．
ex.t: B．它们间接攻击的物种将成为顶级捕食者。

ex.s: It led to a severe food crisis and threatened the livelihood of more than 9.5 million people.
ex.t: 这导致了严重的粮食危机，威胁到超过950万人的生计。

ex.s: I looked out of my study window, over the garden, the field, to the low hills beyond, and the ground went on and on, the sky was thick grey, and all the trees so many black and threatening shapes.
ex.t: 我从书房窗户望出去，越过花园、田野，到远处的低矮山丘，大地无限延伸，天空是浓重的灰色，所有的树都是那么多黑色和威胁的形状。

ex.s: Human activities are threatening animals and plants.
ex.t: 人类活动正在威胁动植物。

ex.s: The balance of nature on our planet (threaten) as a large number of species (drive) to extinction.
ex.t: 地球的自然平衡(威胁)是大量物种(驱动)灭绝。

defs.def: to seem likely to happen or cause sth unpleasant 预示凶兆；有 … 危险

ex.s: Airplanes seed threatening storm cells with a chemical to make small ice crystals fall as rain before they can grow into dangerous hailstones.
ex.t: 飞机向有威胁的风暴云团播撒一种化学物质，使小冰晶在长成危险的冰雹之前就以雨的形式落下。

defs.def: to be a danger to sth 危及；对 … 构成威胁
